Spin, Yoga, and Barre Class Schedules

Glow strives to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can shine. Whether you're taking your first steps into the world of fitness, or you're a seasoned pro, we’re here to help you reach your goals with confidence and joy. Check out our full schedule of classes below, and sign up to join us!

Skip To Class Schedule
Our Classes
Ride

Glow Rides transform you physically, mentally and spiritually. Classes include 40 minutes of rhythm riding cardio with playlists crafted by our teachers that motivate and inspire you to work hard and play harder, followed by core work and a deep stretch.

Barre

Barre is a total body workout focused on low-impact, high intensity movements that LIFT and TONE.

Yin

The practice of yin yoga provides the perfect balance to your active (yang) yoga practices and busy life. Focusing on long-held floor poses combined with breath work and meditationleaving you feeling ahhmazing.

Glow Flow

Power Vinyasa Yoga that seamlessly synchronizes breath and movement. Classes will never be exactly the same, but we follow a specific arc form in every class so classes are challenging yet accessible to all. (Room Heated)

Beats Glow Flow

Our signature Glow Flow set to energizing music. Let go and just flow. Challenge yourself and have fun! (Room heated)

Slow Flow

Same style as Glow Flow in a slower pace class. This class is great for beginners to gain confidence and for all yogis to spend more time exploring each posture. (Outdoor Weather Permitting)

Restore

A great class for all levels, flowing at a gentle pace. Learn new postures, practice a unique flow every class and leave feeling restored in body and mind. (Outdoor Weather Permitting)

Beach Yoga

Practice Yoga on a grassy landing overlooking the beautiful Gulf. All levels class in the same style as our slow flow. Class location: The Gulf Restaurant

Get Directions
Float & Flow

Do yoga on a floating FIT board on the gorgeous and calm setting of the intracoastal waterway where dolphin sightings are common! All levels class. Class location: Orange Beach Wind & Water Center

200 Hour Teacher Training Weekends
Our 200 Hour Training is held over the course of 6 weekends and is divided into two sections: Anatomy
and Spirituality.

Anatomy and The Yoga Body
In the 1st, 2nd and 3rd weekends you will learn yoga through the study of Anatomy and how yoga works
within the body:
Alignment and anatomy of Yoga Postures:
Learn why and how a yoga pose works.
Learn the functionality and benefits.
Learn modifications and advanced variations.
How to see and teach to your students in a way that is relevant and not from a script.
Sequence: A powerful synchronized breath-based vinyasa class sequence that can be scaled to all levels and adapted for a variety of styles of yoga.
How to teach and relate mindfulness practices through the physical body and how to incorporate it into a class.
The dynamics of what makes a class transformative.
How to cue breath and call the sequence effectively.
Principles of communication and creativity in a yoga class.
Philosophy and The Yoga Mind
In the 4th, 5th and 6th weekends you will learn yoga philosophy and how yoga works within the mind:

Yogic philosophy and history and how it applies to teaching today.
Tools for teaching present-moment awareness and how to incorporate in a class.
How to teach spirituality in a tangible way that applies to everybody.
Introduction to meditation and breathwork and how to teach it.
The science and neuroscience of mindfulness and the mind/body connection.
The connection between breath, meditation and spirituality.
The art of seeing, timing and knowing when and what to teach.

What to Expect
In our trainings you can expect to:

Practice yoga daily
Meditate, go on nature walks and rest to process your learning
Be introduced to different styles of yoga
Explore concepts through group discussion
Practice teach
Learn tools to navigate life and discover limiting perceptions & blocks through journaling and self-study
What makes Glow Yoga School different?

Practice teaching: We spend time every day practicing teaching. We practice in groups and you receive positive live feedback from your leaders. Our method allows you to instantly incorporate feedback while you practice. We emphasize your natural strengths by identifying them with you so that you maintain your unique qualities and bring those to your students.
Synchronized breath: Vinyasa flow is to link breath with movement. We teach you which breaths (inhales and exhales) go with each posture so your classes will flow and your students will have that, “It’s over already?!” feeling.
Relaxed Schedule: We maximize our time together and offer frequent breaks so the learning flows just like our yoga classes. We know training can be physically and mentally demanding so we support you so you don’t feel pressured. We always end on time so you get a full night of rest, refreshed for the next day!
Learning what flows: Our trainings are guided by you! No training is the same because each person contributes something unique. Remember the days of lectures and memorizing content that you can barely recall today? We want you to remember and embody what you learn so we teach experiential learning. Discussion guides the flow of each day and what we will learn so each topic is relevant in the moment just like a conversation. In this way you are engaged, take in more information and retain it!
Consistency and Accessibility: Our teaching methodology is accessible yet challenging to all levels. You will be able to teach a class to anyone anywhere. You will learn how to teach classes that are fun, creative, and challenging. The sequence you learn maximizes physical and mental health and can be scaled to every body.
Language that everyone understands: You will learn to use words and language that is accessible to all levels of student with an emphasis on breath over the way the body looks in the pose. The sequence you learn maximizes physical and mental health and can be scaled to Every body.

300 Hour Teacher Training Weekends
300 Hour Teacher Training

Advanced Anatomy + Alignment
Move away from teaching standard scripted alignment cues. Instead master teaching alignment from
what you see in front of you making your words relevant in the moment and your classes powerful and
transformative. “It is through the alignment of the body that I discovered the alignment of my mind, self,
and intelligence.” B.K.S. Iyengar

In depth study of the anatomy of the human body, how muscles, joints and bones function together and how each body is unique and therefore its functionality is as well.
Learn how to pair specific body parts with desired actions to create your own relevant alignment cues that inspire conscious movement in every moment.
Asana/Yoga Postures:
Gain confidence in teaching why and how a yoga pose works.
Learn the functionality, benefits and anatomical connections of the key yoga poses.
Learn the multiple ways we can do each posture including modifications and advanced variations.

Lead A Transformative Class/The Glow Method:
Have you ever taken a yoga class and thought wow that flew by! That is what we call the Glow Method.

Use equations of tension and release to create a perfectly balanced and fulfilling class that is both challenging and restorative.
Understand the rationale for the order and relationship of the poses in the Glow Yoga sequenceto help you create your own sequences knowledgeably.
Use a combination of various teaching tools in every class to give your students a playful and powerful experience on their mats.
Learn how to teach a class that honors both the spiritual essence of yoga and satisfies the mind and body of the modern day world.

Practice Teaching with Personal Coaching

Everyday you will practice teach in small groups to gain insight into patterns in your teaching, keeping what works and transforming what doesn’t.
Master Your voice: Through personalized coaching we’ll help you identify your strengths and build on those so you feel confident in Your Own authentic voice.
When both you and the students are in the exact same moment in time it creates an exhilarating connection for all. Learn how to create this in class.
Teach off the mat connection in class.

Meditation + Breathwork
Yoga began as breath practice and meditation with very little physical movement or postures as we know
today. In this module you will master teaching breath, body, mental and subtle body awareness as tools to
the present moment.

Meditation and breathing techniques including the use of mantras, mudras and malas.
Breath awareness methods including synchronization of breath and other forms of pranayama.
Psychology/Science learn what is actually happening in the brain as a result of breath practice and meditation.
Learn how to incorporate meditation and breath into a flow class.

Creative Sequencing

Learn how to use sequencing to create classes that relate and create results.

How to design a class targeting a specific area of the body or physiological focus
How to design a class for a specific group of students like beginners, athletes or corporate clients
Develop your understanding of the relationship between yoga postures and lifestyle movement
Learn how to teach physiology and philosophy together
Learn how to select the most accessible language your students can relate to.

200 Hour Teacher Training Weekends
Our 200 Hour Training is held over the course of 6 weekends and is divided into two sections: Anatomy
and Spirituality.

Anatomy and The Yoga Body
In the 1st, 2nd and 3rd weekends you will learn yoga through the study of Anatomy and how yoga works
within the body:
Alignment and anatomy of Yoga Postures:
Learn why and how a yoga pose works.
Learn the functionality and benefits.
Learn modifications and advanced variations.
How to see and teach to your students in a way that is relevant and not from a script.
Sequence: A powerful synchronized breath-based vinyasa class sequence that can be scaled to all levels and adapted for a variety of styles of yoga.
How to teach and relate mindfulness practices through the physical body and how to incorporate it into a class.
The dynamics of what makes a class transformative.
How to cue breath and call the sequence effectively.
Principles of communication and creativity in a yoga class.
Philosophy and The Yoga Mind
In the 4th, 5th and 6th weekends you will learn yoga philosophy and how yoga works within the mind:

Yogic philosophy and history and how it applies to teaching today.
Tools for teaching present-moment awareness and how to incorporate in a class.
How to teach spirituality in a tangible way that applies to everybody.
Introduction to meditation and breathwork and how to teach it.
The science and neuroscience of mindfulness and the mind/body connection.
The connection between breath, meditation and spirituality.
The art of seeing, timing and knowing when and what to teach.

What to Expect
In our trainings you can expect to:

Practice yoga daily
Meditate, go on nature walks and rest to process your learning
Be introduced to different styles of yoga
Explore concepts through group discussion
Practice teach
Learn tools to navigate life and discover limiting perceptions & blocks through journaling and self-study
What makes Glow Yoga School different?

Practice teaching: We spend time every day practicing teaching. We practice in groups and you receive positive live feedback from your leaders. Our method allows you to instantly incorporate feedback while you practice. We emphasize your natural strengths by identifying them with you so that you maintain your unique qualities and bring those to your students.
Synchronized breath: Vinyasa flow is to link breath with movement. We teach you which breaths (inhales and exhales) go with each posture so your classes will flow and your students will have that, “It’s over already?!” feeling.
Relaxed Schedule: We maximize our time together and offer frequent breaks so the learning flows just like our yoga classes. We know training can be physically and mentally demanding so we support you so you don’t feel pressured. We always end on time so you get a full night of rest, refreshed for the next day!
Learning what flows: Our trainings are guided by you! No training is the same because each person contributes something unique. Remember the days of lectures and memorizing content that you can barely recall today? We want you to remember and embody what you learn so we teach experiential learning. Discussion guides the flow of each day and what we will learn so each topic is relevant in the moment just like a conversation. In this way you are engaged, take in more information and retain it!
Consistency and Accessibility: Our teaching methodology is accessible yet challenging to all levels. You will be able to teach a class to anyone anywhere. You will learn how to teach classes that are fun, creative, and challenging. The sequence you learn maximizes physical and mental health and can be scaled to every body.
Language that everyone understands: You will learn to use words and language that is accessible to all levels of student with an emphasis on breath over the way the body looks in the pose. The sequence you learn maximizes physical and mental health and can be scaled to Every body.

Advanced Anatomy + Alignment
Move away from teaching standard scripted alignment cues. Instead master teaching alignment from
what you see in front of you making your words relevant in the moment and your classes powerful and
transformative. “It is through the alignment of the body that I discovered the alignment of my mind, self,
and intelligence.” B.K.S. Iyengar

Lead A Transformative Class/The Glow Method:
Have you ever taken a yoga class and thought wow that flew by! That is what we call the Glow Method.

Use equations of tension and release to create a perfectly balanced and fulfilling class that is both challenging and restorative.
Understand the rationale for the order and relationship of the poses in the Glow Yoga sequenceto help you create your own sequences knowledgeably.
Use a combination of various teaching tools in every class to give your students a playful and powerful experience on their mats.
Learn how to teach a class that honors both the spiritual essence of yoga and satisfies the mind and body of the modern day world.

Practice Teaching with Personal Coaching

Everyday you will practice teach in small groups to gain insight into patterns in your teaching, keeping what works and transforming what doesn’t.
Master Your voice: Through personalized coaching we’ll help you identify your strengths and build on those so you feel confident in Your Own authentic voice.
When both you and the students are in the exact same moment in time it creates an exhilarating connection for all. Learn how to create this in class.
Teach off the mat connection in class.

Meditation and breathing techniques including the use of mantras, mudras and malas.

What makes Glow Yoga School different?

Practice teaching: We spend time every day practicing teaching. We practice in groups and you receive positive live feedback from your leaders. Our method allows you to instantly incorporate feedback while you practice. We emphasize your natural strengths by identifying them with you so that you maintain your unique qualities and bring those to your students.
Synchronized breath: Vinyasa flow is to link breath with movement. We teach you which breaths (inhales and exhales) go with each posture so your classes will flow and your students will have that, “It’s over already?!” feeling.
Relaxed Schedule: We maximize our time together and offer frequent breaks so the learning flows just like our yoga classes. We know training can be physically and mentally demanding so we support you so you don’t feel pressured. We always end on time so you get a full night of rest, refreshed for the next day!
Learning what flows: Our trainings are guided by you! No training is the same because each person contributes something unique. Remember the days of lectures and memorizing content that you can barely recall today? We want you to remember and embody what you learn so we teach experiential learning. Discussion guides the flow of each day and what we will learn so each topic is relevant in the moment just like a conversation. In this way you are engaged, take in more information and retain it!
Consistency and Accessibility: Our teaching methodology is accessible yet challenging to all levels. You will be able to teach a class to anyone anywhere. You will learn how to teach classes that are fun, creative, and challenging. The sequence you learn maximizes physical and mental health and can be scaled to every body.
Language that everyone understands: You will learn to use words and language that is accessible to all levels of student with an emphasis on breath over the way the body looks in the pose. The sequence you learn maximizes physical and mental health and can be scaled to Every body.

Free People
Gives Back

Back in the 1970's, a young man named Dick Hayne planted a seed in the maze of streets and trees that make up West Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. He opened a store and called it Free People. Free People nurtured the young people who lived there and shopped there, who looked for a little of their own freedom in the clothes they wore. 

More than a clothing brand, Free People aims to create a lifestyle that’s inclusive and sincere. Whether it’s bespoke experiences or philanthropic efforts, they revel in celebrating their fiercely loyal community.
